title: Minimum Person-to-Cake Distance
description_html:
Given a 2D grid of characters where 1 is a cake and 0 is a person, compute the minimum Manhattan distance between any person cell and any cake cell: |r1 - r2| + |c1 - c2|.

If the grid has no person or no cake, output -1.

Input

First line: m n
Next m lines: n characters each ('0' or '1')

Output

One integer: the minimum person-to-cake distance.

Constraints

  • 1 ≤ m, n ≤ 2000; each cell is '0' or '1'.

Example

2 3
010
000
----
1

The cake at (0,1) and the nearest person at (0,0) or (1,1) are distance 1 apart.

Multi-source BFS: seed all cakes, flood, stop at the first person. See Notes.
